widgets_values: One continuous shot that starts on the first image and lands exactly on the last image. The camera drifts slowly forward while the light shifts naturally between the two moments, and the motion carries all the way through with no cuts.

## AMD MiniMax H3 First-Last-Frame to Video

Requires an account key. Register at https://h3.oneclickamd.ai, then configure it either way below. **One-time setup per machine** — it applies to every workflow:

- Environment variable `H3_GATEWAY_API_KEY`
- Or save the key to `h3_gateway_api_key.txt` in the ComfyUI user directory

If the key is missing, the node fails immediately and tells you the registration URL and the exact file path, so you never sit through a silent 401.

**Your key is not in this workflow.** The node has no `api_key` widget, so the key is never written into the workflow JSON or embedded into exported video metadata. This workflow is safe to share.

If you run your own gateway, override the default address with `H3_GATEWAY_BASE_URL`.

**Pick your own two images.** Both `LoadImage` nodes point at placeholder filenames that are not shipped with this package, so select a start and an end image of your own before running.

**Parameters:** the video keeps the first image's aspect ratio, so there is no `ratio` widget. `resolution` 768P; `duration` 4-15 seconds. A prompt is required — describe the motion that connects the two frames.

To animate a single image instead, open the **Image to Video** template.
